organisations.name: Johannesburg City Parks and Zoo

organisations.name: City Power
organisations.mandate: To distribute and supply electricity reliably across the City of Johannesburg, managing connections, metering, prepaid electricity and outage response.
organisations.description: City Power distributes and supplies electricity to the City of Johannesburg, including connections, metering, prepaid electricity and outage management.

organisations.name: Community Development

organisations.description: Community development and social services supporting residents and community organisations in the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Corporate and Shared Services
organisations.mandate: To provide shared corporate services to the municipality, including human resources, ICT systems and facilities management.
organisations.description: Shared corporate services for the municipality, including human resources, ICT systems and facilities management.

organisations.name: Development Planning
organisations.mandate: To regulate land use and direct spatial planning, town planning and building control in the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Land use management, spatial planning, town planning and building control services in the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Economic Development
organisations.mandate: To drive economic growth, job creation, business support and investment promotion for the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Economic development, job creation, business support and investment promotion for the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.description: Environmental management and municipal infrastructure planning and delivery in the City of Johannesburg, including waste management and regulation and water management and biodiversity.

organisations.name: Finance

organisations.description: Municipal budgeting, revenue collection, accounting and financial management for the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.mandate: To provide municipal legal services, contract management and litigation support to the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Municipal legal services, contract management and litigation support for the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Group Strategy, Policy Coordination and Relations
organisations.mandate: To coordinate strategic planning, policy development, research and intergovernmental and international relations for the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Strategic planning, policy coordination, research, and intergovernmental and international relations for the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Health
organisations.mandate: To provide municipal health services including environmental health inspections and public health protection in the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Human Settlements
organisations.mandate: To deliver housing, title deed programmes and informal settlement upgrades in the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.mandate: To plan and implement area-based public infrastructure and urban development projects for the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Joburg City Theatres
organisations.mandate: To operate the municipal theatre grouping, including the Joburg Theatre, Soweto Theatre and Roodepoort Theatre.
organisations.description: Joburg City Theatres is the municipal theatre grouping, operating the Joburg Theatre, Soweto Theatre and Roodepoort Theatre.

organisations.name: Joburg Connect
organisations.mandate: To handle customer care, service requests, complaints handling and digital services for residents of the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Customer care, service requests, complaints handling and digital services for residents of the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.name: Joburg Market
organisations.mandate: To operate the largest fresh produce market in Africa at City Deep, trading fruit and vegetables for the region.
organisations.description: The Joburg Market at City Deep is the largest fresh produce market in Africa, trading fruit and vegetables for the region.

organisations.name: Joburg Tourism Company
organisations.mandate: To market Johannesburg as a destination, provide visitor information and support events as the City's destination marketing organisation.
organisations.description: The Joburg Tourism Company is the City of Johannesburg destination management organisation for destination marketing, visitor information and events.

organisations.name: Johannesburg Water
organisations.mandate: To supply potable water and manage sanitation and wastewater services across the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Johannesburg Water supplies potable water and manages sanitation and wastewater services across the city.

organisations.name: Johannesburg Social Housing Company
organisations.mandate: To develop and manage social and affordable rental housing in the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: The Johannesburg Social Housing Company develops and manages social and affordable rental housing in the city.

organisations.name: Joburg Property Company
organisations.mandate: To manage the city property estate, including municipal property development, leasing and facilities.
organisations.description: The Joburg Property Company manages the city property estate, including municipal property development, leasing and facilities management.

organisations.name: Johannesburg Roads Agency
organisations.mandate: To plan, construct and maintain the city road network, stormwater infrastructure and road signage.
organisations.description: The Johannesburg Roads Agency plans, constructs and maintains the city road network, stormwater infrastructure and road signage.

organisations.name: Metrobus
organisations.mandate: To operate scheduled public bus transport across the City of Johannesburg metro.

organisations.mandate: To provide public safety services including law enforcement, by-law enforcement and emergency management in the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Public safety services including law enforcement, by-law enforcement and emergency management in the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.mandate: To run social development, welfare and community empowerment programmes in the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Social development, welfare and community empowerment programmes in the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.mandate: To plan transport, public transport and mobility programmes for the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Transport planning, public transport and mobility programmes for the City of Johannesburg.

organisations.mandate: To manage water resources, biodiversity and natural environment conservation in the City of Johannesburg.
organisations.description: Water resource management, biodiversity and natural environment conservation in the City of Johannesburg.
